description: Spear startup repair (PR #195), baseline for the published, unrepaired package (v0.0.192, whose spear and battered sources are byte-identical to v0.0.188). The same simulated donor mutation as spear-bootstrap-simulated launch 1 (15 ft reach and Polearms on the live native Longspear, a controlled test-only stand-in): this session passes only when the unrepaired bytes reproduce the reported mechanism - the generic spear profile failure aborts initialization, no owned spear stays registered, and ordinary weapon price and tooltip queries throw the missing battered-origin exception. It then records the native Summon Monster I menu a new sorcerer sees after that failed startup. Run it only against the unrepaired package; on the repaired candidate it fails by design.
